data.one_liner: Show beautiful animated snackbars using overlays with customizable positions and types.
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to display custom and pre-styled animated snackbars (Material, colorized, and dark rectangles) directly using overlays. It supports multiple snackbar strategies, mobile/desktop positioning settings, and manual removal.
use_when: You need custom animated snack bars or toast-like notifications that display over your UI via overlays.
You want pre-built Material, colorized, or dark snackbar styles with built-in animations.
avoid_when: You require push notifications or local system notifications outside the app window.
strengths: Multiple pre-built styles like Material-UI and rectangles.
Customizable mobile and desktop positioning options.
Supports multiple snackbar handling strategies such as columns, stacking, or removing previous ones.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced properties beyond the provided README examples.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just need standard lightweight native-looking toast messages.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer highly customizable flushbars sliding from top or bottom.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a modern toast notification package with rich styling and builder options.
